ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; notify the driver that a fee was levied without any 'I'm Here' tap or GPS arrival, and remind them the cancellation/waiting-fee buttons may only be used after actually reaching the pickup point (RD-6 not triggered — no route_deviation finding against the driver).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver statement that he was 'on my way' is contradicted by system records: closest GPS approach 1,806 m, no arrival timestamp, no 'I'm Here' tap [F1][F3][F4]; statements yield to system records.

The $6.61 cancellation fee was not chargeable: rider cancelled 2 min 30 s after matching, within the 3-minute free-cancellation window (NS-4), and no valid no-show basis exists under NS-1 [F2][F3][F4].
